d:
Begusray men pati ki gumshudgi ki riport darj karane vali patni hi hatya ki sajish men shamil nikli.
Pulis ke mutabik, doli ne premi mukesh ke sath milkar pati dhiraj ray ki hatya karvaee aur shav ganga nadi men phenk diya.
Pulis ne patni doli kumari aur uske premi mukesh kumar ko giraphtar kar jel bhej diya hai.
